prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1168; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while executing a left turn. Presenting complaints included neck pain, stiffness, and headaches beginning the day after the incident, with reduced range of motion in cervical flexion and rotation and tenderness over the paraspinal musculature and upper trapezius bilaterally. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits or radicular symptoms reported.

Diagnosis: cervical strain consistent with whiplash-associated disorder.

Over the course of care, the patient attended 18 visits consisting of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for deep cervical flexors and scapular stabilizers, and home exercise instruction. Pain scores improved from moderate at intake to mild at discharge, and cervical range of motion approached functional norms. Headache frequency decreased substantially over the treatment period.

At discharge, the patient was reporting intermittent stiffness with prolonged positioning but was able to resume usual daily activities and occupational duties. Continued home exercise and ergonomic modification were recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
